The provided text aligns strongly with the core themes of the cyberpunk genre. It features a dystopian urban setting ("Neo-Tokyo"), a stark contrast between high technology and low life (implied by the clash between hackers and megacorps), and the central role of cyberspace or the "net" as a distinct reality. The protagonist, Zara, is a classic cyberpunk archetype—a cybernetic operative who navigates both physical and digital worlds. The themes of information as currency and corporate control are also staple elements of the genre.

Regarding your question about dental hygiene: I use a toothbrush to clean my teeth.
